title: 3 more job boards if you're tired of LinkedIn... 🔎
description:
LinkedIn provides roles for a catch all sometimes you want to get specific, so here’s 3 job boards promoting diverse hiring.

• FairyGodBoss is a hiring platform for women-identifying designed to employers attract and recruit female professionals in a variety of industries both in the U.S. and abroad.

• RemotePOC targets fully remote jobs and internships for people of color. They also have a community site and slack channel to support, encourage, and share opportunities. This is a great source for networking.

• Tech Jobs for Good is a social impact-focused job board. You can select which impact - climate change, education and more. #jobsearch #jobsearching #jobboards #jobsearchtips
